title: Five-qubit code [[5,1,3]] on cyclone_base — a loop with no junctions
claim: Cyclone's base: rotation on a loop without spurs

marks.label: cool
marks.note: the lattice cools too; 13% of its round.

marks.label: a typical shuttle
marks.note: a handful of ions, each on its own route: the 80% of this round that is transport is made of instructions like this one.

marks.label: the busiest shuttle (2 ions) / 2 directions at once
marks.note: the most ions this router ever moves at once, against a ring rotation's 144. The mean is 1.1. The device declares 18 SIMD classes (row and column shifts); the router issues only `shuttle`.  ALSO: ions moving 2 different ways in one instruction. A ring rotation asks for one. On the 32-channel broadcast block this needs 2 channels -- legal, and the reason q06h's 'a lattice cannot use broadcast' was withdrawn.
